findings.statement: at about eight live pieces, point reads are at least 0.85x the routed store's
findings.detail: 126 ns per read over 1 live pieces against 123 ns routed (tail-8 vs routed: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 0.984, p=0.2980) -- within noise, not a result); at 1 pieces 132 ns (tail-4 vs routed: less 0.930x (p=0.0131, rel_iqr 2.5%/7.0%)), at 1 pieces 160 ns (tail-15 vs routed: less 0.813x (p=0.0131, rel_iqr 20.2%/7.0%)). f44 had eight segments at 0.77x before inline runs, when a probe was four misses ending in a block

findings.statement: at about eight live pieces, ingest-to-drain is at least 1.3x the routed store's
findings.detail: tail-8 789351 ops/s against routed 533370 (tail-8 vs routed: greater 1.480x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 4.4%/6.9%)); tail-4 777675 (tail-4 vs routed: greater 1.458x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 2.5%/6.9%)); tail-15 761827. Phases tail-8 against routed: commit 0.010s/0.010s, seal 0.011s/0.011s, merge 0.000s/0.010s; device bytes 5.9 against 9.2 MB. The drain's merge is gone and the seals overlap the load

findings.statement: at about four live pieces, point reads are within 5% of the routed store's
findings.detail: 132 ns per read over 1 live pieces against 123 ns routed (tail-4 vs routed: less 0.930x (p=0.0131, rel_iqr 2.5%/7.0%)). Each piece beyond the first costs a Bloom check and, on a false positive, a two-miss probe

findings.statement: at about eight live pieces the ordered scan is at most half the routed rate
findings.detail: 35524610 entries/s over 1 pieces against 62921970 routed (0.561x, tail-8 vs routed: less 0.561x (p=0.0051, rel_iqr 6.3%/8.6%)). A single-partition walk becomes a k-way merge over pieces; this is the price of leaving routing to compaction, stated beside the gain

notes: four arms interleaved in one process, fresh store per rep, the canonical shape with the drain inside the window. routed is today's default (32 MB seals, trigger 4, the flush partitions what it sealed); tail-4, tail-8 and tail-15 leave the store unrouted with about that many live pieces after the drain (32/16/8 MB seals with a trigger the load never reaches). Then point reads and one ordered scan over the drained store, so the price of fan-out is measured with inline runs in place
predictions registered in tailbound-plan.md before the run
